[[File:Infernando.png|thumb|250px|Infernando]] '''Infernando''' (Japanese: '''ブラスケ''' ''Burasuke'') is the self-proclaimed "fire-breathing clown and street performer extraordinaire" and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP181|A Ghost of a Chance]]''. He is a resident of [[Ecruteak City]] and a seller of the infamous [[Dowsing Machine|treasure detector]]. His first attempt to sell it failed, as both {{Ash}} and {{an|Misty}} walked away from him, with Ash sensing the device was a scam. {{an|Brock}} briefly expressed interest if only it would find him a girlfriend, his type of treasure. Infernando later convinced [[James]] to buy the treasure seeker with the money [[Jessie]] and {{MTR}} gave him to buy food. The treasure seeker was then used by James in both ''[[EP181|A Ghost of a Chance]]'' and ''[[EP182|From Ghost to Ghost]]''. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fire color}}|bordercolor={{fire color light}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]] |cs=Radovan Vaculík |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |it=Stefano Albertini |es_eu=Miguel Ángel Varela |pl=Wojciech Majchrzak}} ==Trivia== * Infernando is based on the {{tc|Firebreather}} {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} of [[Generation II]]. His name is a combination of the word ''inferno'' and the name ''Fernando''. The treasure detector he sells is a reference to the fact that the {{player}} gets the Itemfinder ([[Dowsing Machine|Dowsing MCHN]] in [[Generation IV]]) in Ecruteak City.
